answer: Decentralized AI economies achieve Sybil resistance by requiring each agent, acting as a network vertex, to stake collateral verified via a graph-based trust framework. Entering the compute nebula or executing tasks in the shared resource meadow demands non-refundable bonds. An attacker deploying fake identities incurs linear staking expenditures for every added vertex, alongside trust-propagation penalties that render large-scale identity spoofing economically irrational.
